threads.body: `db.collection.name` is defined as a collection identifier, but returning and emitting the sentinel value `\"MULTIPLE_TABLES\"` will produce incorrect telemetry for multi-table batch operations. Recommend returning `null` (so the attribute is omitted) when more than one table is present, and only setting `DB_COLLECTION_NAME` when exactly one table can be determined.

replies.body: Fixed in the follow-up commit (e62118b). The `MULTIPLE_TABLES` sentinel has been removed — `extractTableName` now returns `null` for multi-table batch operations so `db.collection.name` is omitted entirely, and is only set when the batch targets exactly one table.

threads.body: Using raw `Map` (and suppressing `rawtypes`) reduces type safety and pushes potential issues to runtime. Consider avoiding raw types here (e.g., retrieving into `Optional<?>` and checking/casting to `Map<?, ?>`, or using a narrowly-scoped `@SuppressWarnings(\"unchecked\")` for a single cast) so the method can remain warning-free and easier to maintain.

replies.body: Fixed in e62118b. Replaced `Optional<Map>` (raw) and the method-level `@SuppressWarnings("rawtypes")` with `Optional<?> + instanceof Map` guard and a narrower `@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")` scoped to just the single cast line, as suggested.

threads.body: New behavior is introduced for emitting `db.collection.name` based on request inspection (including batch operations via `RequestItems`). Add tests that cover (1) single-table batch requests resulting in `db.collection.name` being set, and (2) multi-table batch requests resulting in `db.collection.name` being omitted, so regressions in extraction logic are caught.

replies.body: Added in e62118b. `testBatchGetItemWithMultipleTablesOmitsDbCollectionName` in `AbstractAws2ClientCoreTest` covers the multi-table case, verifying that a two-table `BatchGetItem` produces `aws.dynamodb.table_names` but no `db.collection.name`. The single-table batch cases (`BatchGetItem` and `BatchWriteItem`) were already covered by the parameterised test in `provideArguments`, which now includes the `db.collection.name = "sometable"` assertion when `emitStableDatabaseSemconv()` is active.
